changes.reason: The table argument accepts the new table cdp_neighbor (CDP neighbours of Cisco IOS, IOS XE and NX-OS from the opt-in cdp_neighbors query). The records of the existing tables gain optional fields: interface.mac and interface.mtu, ip_interface.mac and ip_interface.gateway; they are null where a platform does not supply them. Linux now returns the interface, ip_interface, route, neighbor_l3 and mac_entry tables from its existing catalogue queries, which adds no table name.
